recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It narrowly completes the missing invariant from FHIR-20176 while preserving the already-applied CodeableReference structure; broader BodyStructure guidance should remain with later OO/PC issues.
issue_request: FHIR-20176 asked whether Claim.item.bodySite/subSite overlapped with BodyStructure. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution changed Claim/ExplanationOfBenefit item bodySite and ClaimResponse.addItem bodySite to a repeating bodySite backbone with site[x] as either a coded body site or Reference(BodyStructure), retained subSite as coded detail, and required an invariant preventing subSite when siteReference exists.
initial_application: The historical application commit acb64eec3ca82f9a8d18d4091f2416029ee45dcd changed the relevant Claim-family structures to bodySite BackboneElement with repeating site CodeableReference(BodyStructure) and bodySite.subSite CodeableConcept. It also applied the same pattern to ExplanationOfBenefit.addItem.bodySite. The current source preserved that structure but lacked the requested business rule.
additional_context: Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The current source represents the Jira site[x]/siteReference shape as CodeableReference, so the invariant is expressed as site.reference.exists() implies subSite.empty(). FHIR-38849 and FHIR-54843 were reviewed as related BodyStructure/subSite context, but neither supersedes the Published FM decision being reconciled here. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Added error constraints clm-1, eob-1, eob-2, and clr-1 to Claim.item.bodySite, ExplanationOfBenefit.item.bodySite, ExplanationOfBenefit.addItem.bodySite, and ClaimResponse.addItem.bodySite respectively.
source_changes: source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml: added clm-1 on Claim.item.bodySite requiring site.reference.exists() implies subSite.empty().
source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml: added eob-1 on ExplanationOfBenefit.item.bodySite and eob-2 on ExplanationOfBenefit.addItem.bodySite with the same rule.
source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml: added clr-1 on ClaimResponse.addItem.bodySite with the same rule.
